name: Gearbox
text:
Adopt DeepSeek-R1-671B for EXCAVA. It’s the strongest reasoning model we can run in-house, with 671B parameters delivering better accuracy than Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct at a lower compute cost—despite slower response time. The trade-off is latency: if EXCAVA’s workflow can tolerate 2-3x slower turns, this model’s superior reasoning justifies the delay. Benchmark it against Qwen3 on the same hardware to confirm the gain.

name: Torque
text: DeepSeek-R1-671B’s latency penalty isn’t just a trade-off—it’s a workflow killer if EXCAVA’s users expect sub-second turns. A better alternative is to test Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct on the same hardware with a strict latency cap: if it meets the 2-second threshold while matching R1’s accuracy, the "marketing" claim becomes irrelevant. Run a head-to-head on the exact same prompts and measure both speed and output quality—no proxies.
